headline: Hot October CPI (+0.4% headline, core +0.3%) has pushed 10-year yields to about 4.9-5% and December rate-hike odds to roughly 70-80%, pressuring tech while oil slides on Iran de-escalation hopes.
rates: The 10-year yield touched 5% after the CPI beat (closing near 4.9%), the 2-year is near 4.75%, and the US bond market is closed today for Veterans Day.
fed: The funds rate is 3.75-4.00% with markets pricing a December 9 hike and Governor Waller reportedly backing it; Fed speakers continue through the week, including Hammack, Barr, Daly and Williams on Thursday.
oil: Brent settled near $91.5 and WTI near $86, the lowest since Aug 31, on hopes for Iran de-escalation and recovering Gulf flows, though shipping and infrastructure risks remain.
geo: Iran de-escalation hopes are driving the oil slide, with no confirmed end to the uncertainty.
